17.description: This feature vector represents common Thai script characters and subword tokens.

152.description: This vector activates on a diverse mix of multilingual subword fragments, phonetic characters, and short lexical roots spanning English, Thai, and Latin-script languages.

164.description: This feature vector represents the Thai consonant letter 'ม' (Mo Ma) combined with various Thai vowels, tone marks, and preceding words.

192.description: This vector activates on various sub-word tokens, punctuation marks, and multi-lingual characters that appear frequently in ungrammatical or noisy web-scraped text.

40.description: This vector represents conjunctions and disjunctions across multiple languages, including words and symbols meaning "and" or "or".

45.description: This feature vector activates strongly on language names, country demonyms, and linguistic script fragments across multiple writing systems.

130.description: This feature vector activates on Thai language subword prefixes and structural morphemes, particularly variations of the preposition/prefix "กับ" (gab) and related consonantal clusters.

113.description: This feature vector is related to subword fragments, technical tokens, and multi-lingual characters often associated with data corruption or encoding artifacts.

28.description: This feature vector activates on isolated consonant letters and short phonetic subword fragments.

89.description: This vector represents multilingual text fragments, punctuation marks, and sub-word tokens with a high concentration of Thai script characters.
